msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional male fashion model (a man). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia presintown-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish man in his thirties wearing a navy blue tailored suit with a light blue shirt and a patterned tie on a mannequin from the reference, walking at a sunny street in the centre of Lorca, Murcia, Spain, with baroque facades and balconies, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a navy blue tailored blazer on a hanger from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a light blue Oxford cotton shirt for men, folded (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a camel cable-knit crew neck jumper for men, folded (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of beige cotton chino trousers for men, folded (flat lay) from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
